title: Fourier coefficient of a difference
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $f,g:G\to\mathbb{C}$, and let $\chi$ be an additive character of $G$. The Fourier coefficient of $f-g$ at $\chi$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\chi$ minus that of $g$ at $\chi$.
